_comment: Example probes file for elementfrompoint-sweep.mjs — Spec 36 §8 / FR-36-16. This is a PER-VIEWPORT config (one key per requested --viewports width). Copy this file, rename it per client/mockup, and replace every selector with the ones your page renders (sgs/nav-bar-menu, sgs/nav-drawer-menu and sgs/nav-drawer emit the classes shown here). Do NOT point real gate runs at this example file — it is documentation, not a fixture.

375._comment: Mobile: the burger opens the full-screen drawer. Baseline target: 10/10 on Mama's.

768._comment: Tablet: same drawer pattern as mobile, geometry differs.

1440._comment: Desktop: no drawer — probe an OPEN mega panel instead. openSelector targets the mega trigger, not the burger. A desktop mega is not modal (no scrim, nothing inert), so there is no below-the-panel occlusion probe; the panel probe below proves nothing overlays the panel itself.
